choice.basis: The pie chart explicitly labels each segment with its global energy consumption share: Nuclear (40%), Hydroelectric (25%), Renewables (20%), and Fossil Fuels (15%). The chart title confirms the scope is global energy consumption. The task requires routing the largest category. Nuclear (40%) is the largest by percentage, and the option 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring' is available and directly matches this source.
choice.option_label: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring
